data: When you are subject to a ranged attack, use your reaction to take half the damage dealt now and on any ranged attack that targets you until the beginning of your next turn.
Prevents the user from being startled one time this turn.
You are immune to first CHA Saving Throw you would have to make this round.

You create a wall of light that protects your allies from Ranged Attacks in a {shape} centered on a point within range. While in the light, all damage dealt to allied creatures by ranged attacks is halved.
